title: Unauthorized MMS Supervisory Control in IEC 61850 Digital Substations: From Attack Scenarios to a Labeled Dataset
description:
Dataset accompanying the ESORICS/CyberICPS 2026 paper 'Unauthorized MMS Supervisory Control in IEC 61850 Digital Substations: From Attack Scenarios to a Labeled Dataset'. Contains the normalized full-corpus MMS capture (428,204 records, gzip-compressed CSV and JSONL), reviewed ground-truth labels, scenario summaries, and a sample subset for lightweight validation.

Files included:
- mms_capture_normalized.csv.gz — all 428,204 MMS records, flat schema, ground-truth labels merged in
- mms_capture_normalized.jsonl.gz — same corpus in JSONL format
- mms_full_capture_supervised_labels.csv — reviewed ground-truth labels (final_tag, seed_is_attack, supervised_is_anomaly, scenario_id, scenario_role)
- mms_full_capture_scenario_summary.csv — per-scenario attack summary
- mms_prepared_supervised_labels.csv / mms_prepared_scenario_summary.csv — prepared-subset equivalents
- scenario_event_review.csv / scenario_review.csv — manual review records
- mms_sample_100k.csv / mms_sample_100k.jsonl — 100k-record sample subset
- mms_sample_attack_tags.csv / mms_ml_features_100k.csv / mms_sequence_windows.csv — derived sample assets

The companion software artifact (baseline IDS implementation, scripts, configs) is available separately on Zenodo.
